principle: Hot-path Hermes hooks must add zero blocking IO when memory.provider=mastra is selected; all real work is async/buffered/observed via Observer/Reflector.
baseline_baseline_collection_method: tests/perf/bench_hot_path.py drives 200 simulated turns through MastraMemoryProvider with the live server fixture (B02) and emits per-hook p50/p99 ms in /Users/kiren/hermes-setup/memory/hermes-mastra/analysis/perf-baseline.json.

prefetch.contract: cache-only return; HTTP work happens in queue_prefetch
prefetch.notes: background thread populates self._prefetch_result; hot-path returns immediately

sync_turn.contract: enqueue to bounded queue; never await HTTP
sync_turn.notes: async_runner background queue (default size 1024) flushes to Mastra

on_memory_write.contract: enqueue mirror; MEMORY.md/USER.md disk write completes inline (existing behavior); Mastra mirror is enqueued

on_pre_compress.contract: enqueue Reflector distill; return synchronous extraction string from cache (or empty if cache cold)
on_pre_compress.notes: G07 must boost density without violating budget

on_session_end.contract: enqueue session summary; do not block
on_session_end.notes: the summary itself is computed offline by the Reflector

on_session_switch.contract: update in-memory cached state; never block

system_prompt_block.notes: called per turn during prompt build

hard_floor.rule: median per-turn overhead added by the plugin <= 50 ms p50 and <= 250 ms p99 vs. the built-in MEMORY.md/USER.md baseline (G3).

regression_gate: X01 re-runs CC_PERF_BENCH after REFACTOR; perf-final.json diffed against perf-baseline.json must show no regression.
